notes: Posted 16 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Credited as R. Smith (plain text), matching this player's other DeckTech pages (e.g. 18160, 18598).

Starting cards as posted under 'Start (8)': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, You Cannot Hide Forever and Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'YD' dested Your Destiny (the Effect the Objective deploys with Throne Room and Insignificant Rebellion); 'IAO' Imperial Arrest Order; 'palpatine' Emperor Palpatine (the strategy deploys Palpatine with Janus; Senator Palpatine is a later Coruscant card); 'maul the @#$%' Darth Maul (Tatooine).

Posted 'coruscant system' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant (the Coruscant-set printing was not yet out); 'Cantina' and 'Endor docking bay' dested the Dark pages; 'weap lev' the Dark Cloud City Weapon Levitation; 'fett in slave' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'bossk in bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'cmere ya big coward' Come Here You Big Coward.
Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Special Edition Effects, posted under 'effects (3)'.
'guys (14)' lists 15 characters; total is 60 as published.
The description mentions going 2-0 at an unnamed local tournament; general deck.
